description: Compare two artifacts of the same supported format and return deepbom.semantic_artifact_diff.v1. TFLite results also retain the target-bound deployment delta. The comparison does not prove lineage, runtime behaviour, task quality, or regulatory significance.

baseline.description: Local or immutable remote baseline artifact or package.

cache_dir.description: Content-addressed cache directory under the allowed roots.

candidate.description: Local or immutable remote candidate artifact or package of the same format.

expected_sha256.description: Expected digest for the baseline source. Use independently pinned remote URLs for both artifacts when possible.

offline.description: Refuse network access and require verified cache receipts.

target.description: Optional TFLite target profile id for the embedded pinned cost model.

tensor_limit.description: Maximum changed-tensor rows to return; requires tensors=true.

tensor_offset.description: Zero-based changed-tensor row offset; requires tensors=true.

tensors.description: Return the tensor-encoding transition projection instead of the full semantic diff.

name: deepbom_diff
title: Compare two model artifacts
